$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the multi-target build. Edit this, then run `npm run build` to regenerate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, plugins/*, and manifest.json. CI (`npm test`) fails if the generated files drift from this config.

marketplace.name: lightcone-research
marketplace.description: Agent skills for the Lightcone Research stack — the ASTRA spec and lightcone-cli project workflows.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and composition mechanics. Standalone — use ASTRA without the rest of the Lightcone stack. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Core workflow for a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: `lc-new` scopes a new analysis from a research question, `lc-cli` carries the lc execution reference (spec–code invariant, status interpretation, failure diagnosis), and `lc-feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Depends on the astra plugin. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project.

plugins.name: lightcone-experimental
plugins.description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Paper reproduction (`lc-from-paper`), code import (`lc-from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), autonomous iteration (`ralph`), and manuscript verification (`check-sentence-by-sentence`, `figure-comparison`). Depends on the core lightcone plugin. Install when you need capabilities beyond the core analysis workflow.
